
```{r}

  genes_use <- intersect(

    rownames(milo_hsc_obj)                                                                   
  )                                                                                        
                                                                                         
  nhood_markers <- miloR::findNhoodMarkers(                                                
    milo_hsc_obj[genes_use, ],
    da.res            = milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,                                  
    assay             = "logcounts",

    sample_col        = "dm2_class",

```

```{r}
hood_groups_res <-   miloR::groupNhoods(milo_hsc_obj[genes_use, ],
                                        da.res            = milo_hsc_da$mChPos_vs_WT$da_results,
                                        da.fdr = 1,
                                        merge.discord = TRUE,
                                        overlap = 20
                                        )                                                                                    

hood_groups_res %>%
  dplyr::count(NhoodGroup)

hood_groups_res %>%
  dplyr::count(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9,NhoodGroup)

nhood_markers <- miloR::findNhoodGroupMarkers(                                                
  milo_hsc_obj[genes_use, ],
  da.res            = hood_groups_res,                                  
  assay             = "logcounts",                                                     
  aggregate.samples = TRUE,                   
  sample_col        = "dm2_class",
)                                                                                      

group_hood_annot <- hood_groups_res %>%
    dplyr::distinct(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9,NhoodGroup) %>%
  group_by(NhoodGroup)%>%
  summarize(x = paste(sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9,collapse = ","))%>%
  ungroup()

nhood_markers %>%
  pivot_longer(-GeneID) %>% 
  separate_wider_delim(cols = name,delim = "_",names = c("stat","group")) %>% 
  pivot_wider(names_from = stat, values_from = value) %>%
  inner_join(group_hood_annot,by = c("group" = "NhoodGroup"))

```

```{r}
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mix <- Seurat::MixingMetric(
  object       = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
  grouping.var = "sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.1.5",
  reduction    = "umap.nn",
  k = 500,max.k = 500)


VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, features = "mix",group.by = "sample.name")

Seurat::FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
                    "mix",
                    reduction = "umap.nn")


reduction <- "umap.nn"
verbose <- TRUE
dims <- 1:2
eps <- 0
k <- 5
grouping.var <- "grp"
my.sapply <- ifelse(test = verbose && nbrOfWorkers() == 1,
                    yes = pbapply::pbsapply, 
                    no = future_sapply)
embeddings <- Embeddings(object = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[[reduction]])[, 
    dims]
nn <- RANN::nn2(data = embeddings, k = max.k, eps = )
group.info <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[[grouping.var, drop = TRUE]]
groups <- unique(x = group.info)
mixing <- my.sapply(X = 1:ncol(x = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc), FUN = function(x) {
    sapply(X = groups, FUN = function(y) {
        which(x = group.info[nn$nn.idx[x, ]] == y)[k]
    })
})
mixing[is.na(x = mixing)] <- max.k
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$mix  <- apply(X = mixing, MARGIN = 2, FUN = median)


VlnPlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, features = "mix",group.by = "sample.name")

```

neighbors expression entropy

```{r}
nn_index <- mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc@neighbors$neighbors_pca.SCT_30@nn.idx
genes <- VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
expr_matrix <- GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                            assay = "SCT", 
                            layer = "data")[genes,]
n_cells <- ncol(expr_matrix)
local_entropy_per_cell <- sapply(seq_len(n_cells), function(i) {
  neighbors <- nn_index[i, ]
  expr_local <- expr_matrix[, neighbors]
  # For each gene, variance in the local neighborhood
  apply(expr_local, 1, var)
  }) %>%
  t()
rownames(local_entropy_per_cell) <- colnames(expr_matrix)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- AddMetaData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,local_entropy_per_cell)
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc$avg_entropy <- apply(local_entropy_per_cell,1,mean)
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,features = c("Pf4", "sct_Pf4"))&
  scale_color_viridis_c()
FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            features = "avg_entropy")+
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")
```

```{r}
BiocManager::install('OmnipathR')
BiocManager::install('saezlab/decoupleR')
net <- decoupleR::get_progeny(organism = 'mouse', top = 500)

genes <- VariableFeatures(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc)
mat <- GetAssayData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, 
                            assay = "SCT", 
                            layer = "data")[genes,]%>%
  as.matrix()

# Run mlm
acts <- decoupleR::run_mlm(mat = mat, 
                           net = net, 
                           .source = 'source', 
                           .target = 'target',
                           .mor = 'weight', 
                           minsize = 5)

# Extract mlm and store it in pathwaysmlm in data
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[['pathwaysmlm']] <- acts %>%
                         tidyr::pivot_wider(id_cols = 'source', 
                                            names_from = 'condition',
                                            values_from = 'score') %>%
                         tibble::column_to_rownames(var = 'source') %>%
                         Seurat::CreateAssayObject(.)

# Change assay
Seurat::DefaultAssay(object = mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc) <- "pathwaysmlm"

# Scale the data
mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc <- Seurat::ScaleData(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,assay = "pathwaysmlm")

FeaturePlot(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc,
            features = rownames(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc[["pathwaysmlm"]]),
            assay ="pathwaysmlm",
            slot = "scale.data" ,
            order = F)&
  scale_color_viridis_c(option = "turbo")

```

```{r}
srt_sub <- subset(mpn_processed_hsc_fullcc, sNN_pca.SCT_30_res.0.9 %in% c("6", "8"))
bin_counts <- GetAssayData(srt_sub,assay = "SCT",layer = "counts")>1
bin_sum <- aggregate(t(bin_counts),
                     list(Region = srt_sub$sample.name), 
                     sum) %>%
  column_to_rownames("Region") %>%
  t() %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>% 
  rownames_to_column("gene")

bin_sum %>%
    filter(`HSC_WT_CD41+` <=1) %>% 
    pivot_longer(-gene)%>%
    group_by(gene) %>% 
    filter(!all(value == 0)) %>%
    ungroup() %>% 
    filter(name != "HSC_WT_CD41+") %>% 
    ggplot(aes(log10(value+1), fill = name))+
    geom_histogram(bins = 100)+
    facet_wrap(~name)+
    scale_x_continuous()
```
